prompt: Review an unseen state-and-cache workload packet. Choose the smallest justified data-store portfolio, design keys and cache behavior, diagnose one stale/hot/eviction/repair incident, and revise the design after the reviewer changes one major correctness, scale, geography, privacy or cost constraint.
deliverables: Operation invariant acknowledgement and source-of-truth table.
Access-pattern inventory with key predicates order page size value size rates bursts consistency retention and growth.
Partition/shard and secondary-index keys with cardinality skew hottest-key and atomic-scope analysis.
Operation-level read/write/session consistency and failure behavior.
Cache key version fill write invalidation TTL jitter negative stale coalescing and origin-protection design.
Memory throughput storage replication repair and failure-capacity calculations.
Incident timeline containment recovery reconciliation and user validation.
Identity authorization encryption privacy deletion observability and cost controls.
Changed-constraint decision ADR delayed explanation and exact cleanup proof.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unfamiliar sanitized workload distributions topology histories and one changed constraint.
No production endpoint credential customer data shared network destructive cache flush or unapproved fault injection.
Every state field has one authority or an explicit merge/reconciliation direction.
Selection follows measured access and invariant scope rather than product familiarity.
Partition analysis includes secondary indexes and hottest-key behavior, not average cardinality alone.
Cache hits are checked for freshness and authorization where relevant; cache failure has explicit origin behavior.
TTL is never substituted for a correctness retention window such as idempotency or authorization revocation.
Write-behind acknowledgements require durable buffering idempotent sink and reconciliation.
Recovery prevents stale refill and proves user and privacy outcomes.
Reviewer observes changed-constraint reasoning delayed recall safety and cleanup.
